workflowRecommendation: Work Tasks 1-4 (up.sh) in order; Tasks 5 (down.sh), 6-7 (checkpoints.sh), and 8 (docs) only need Task 1's lib.sh and can be interleaved. Task 9 is the real kind run on this box - the implementer's production-like proof, required before the phase completes. Task 11 (biome, tsc, harnesses, shellcheck) runs once at the end.
tasks: 2 up.sh cluster, IPv4 gateway by regex, NATS/Postgres containers (docker label legion-smoke.instance), go build listener+dispatch, host processes with pid+start-tick records

3 up.sh Dispatch seed (header identity), overlay generated from the checkout copy, kubectl kustomize check, apply, crash-loop detection, supervised port-forward, probe-pass wait, probe-contract record
4 up.sh controller decision (checkout, non-mutating 403/404 route probe, plugin contract), envoy-bridge.ts (GitHub subjects only) + test, root issues, KIND SMOKE READY block
5 down.sh by record with ownership checks + down.test.sh
8 README, docs/kubernetes.md runbook + troubleshooting, root and daemon AGENTS.md, CI harness step
9 real kind run on this box (two instances: default and SMOKE_ROOT_ISSUES=2 SMOKE_WORKER_CAP=1), negative controls, implement handoff proof
10 pull request in READY format, tier T4

decisions.instance: SMOKE_INSTANCE defaults to LEGION_ISSUE lowercased alnum, else USER; must match ^[a-z0-9]{1,9}$ so the Dispatch project key S<INSTANCE> fits ^[A-Z][A-Z0-9]{1,9}$
decisions.ports: SMOKE_PORT_BASE (default 31000): +0 NATS, +1 Envoy listener, +2 Dispatch, +3 Postgres, +4 daemon port-forward; each checked with ss -H -ltn unless the instance's own record proves the listener is ours (container label / pid+start ticks)
decisions.gateway: cluster first (kind creates the network), then docker network inspect kind, IPv4 gateway chosen by regex (the IPv6 IPAM entry is first on this box); containers publish -p <gateway>:<port>, host processes bind the gateway
decisions.dispatch: own scratch server built with go build from packages/envoy/cmd/dispatch; DATABASE_URL to the instance Postgres, DISPATCH_AGENT_TOKEN generated, DISPATCH_IDENTITY=header:X-Dispatch-User + DISPATCH_ALLOWED_LOGINS=smoke (no bind-address restriction; the header is trusted per request), NATS_URLS so the outbox publishes into instance NATS directly, ENVOY_URL/ENVOY_TOKEN for its listener client; project key S<INSTANCE>; human-only routes via the header, reads via the bearer
decisions.controllerNone: three ordered checks: checkout has controller.yaml.example and `legion controller start --help`; a POST /legion/v1/controller/secret with a deliberately wrong bearer answers 403 (present) vs 404 (absent) - nothing minted, nothing revoked; the profile plugin's legion.daemonApiVersion equals the image daemon's contract read from its probe log line. Only then a pane opens; the pane is recorded before it is watched
decisions.portForward: setsid'd bash loop restarting kubectl port-forward --address 127.0.0.1 svc/legion-daemon-demo <base+4>:13370; recorded as a process group; down.sh kills the group
decisions.activePhase: the redacted state has no phases: a role is taken as the active phase when its claim has a Running pod, readyConfirmedAt, and the issue's Dispatch status matches the role (tester=testing, implementer/planner=in_progress, reviewer=needs_review, merger=retro)
decisions.sessionFile: roles[].locator carries no ompSessionFile: under pvc the exact path is read from the pod before the kill (ls sessions/*/*_<sessionId>.jsonl) and compared to --resume=; under postgres --resume= must end with _<sessionId>.jsonl; the architect role uses trees[].locator.ompSessionFile exactly
decisions.phaseCompletes: the issue's Dispatch status leaves its kill-time value or a successor role's claim appears
decisions.downRefusal: '<state dir> has no instance record: this directory never started a kind smoke; stopping nothing, deleting nothing', exit 0
decisions.realRun: on this box there is no secrets CLI: run under /home/legion/.local/bin/legion-pane-env with SMOKE_IMPLEMENT_APP_KEY_FILE=/etc/legion/implementer.pem SMOKE_REVIEW_APP_KEY_FILE=/etc/legion/reviewer.pem SMOKE_OMP_LAUNCH_PREFIX=; kind v0.24.0 and kubectl v1.31.0 must be downloaded to ~/.local/bin; go via mise x go@1.26

concerns: Spec Acceptance 3 says the session file is recorded 'from daemon state'; the redacted GET /legion/v1/state omits ompSessionFile on role locators (only trees[] and controllerLocator carry it) and has no phases. The plan recovers the file from the pod under pvc and asserts by session id under postgres; changing the wire shape is out of scope (no LegionDaemonApi change).

Spec Acceptance 1 names `secrets ... -- bash scripts/kind-smoke/up.sh`; this box has no secrets CLI (provider keys reach panes through /home/legion/.local/bin/legion-pane-env from /etc/legion/provider.env; the App keys are /etc/legion/{implementer,reviewer}.pem). up.sh accepts both forms; the README carries both lines.

legion controller start (PR #1110) is not on main and PR #1110 is CONFLICTING: on today's main every run records controller: none and `done` prints SKIPPED-BLOCKED; an image built after #1110 against a pre-#1110 checkout (or the reverse) crash-loops the daemon on legion.yaml keys - up.sh reports the log lines and leaves the cluster, as the spec's Errors table says.
The `done` checkpoint verifies merged pull requests with `gh pr list` (the worker-bin shim inside a Legion pane, the operator's gh outside); without gh it reports SKIPPED-BLOCKED.
worker-cap needs a second instance (SMOKE_ROOT_ISSUES=2 SMOKE_WORKER_CAP=1); with cap 1 the promotion waits for the first planner's idle-retire (600 s), so its budget is 1800 s.
The Dispatch binary booting API-only without DISPATCH_WEB_DIST is inferred from its boot code, not yet observed; Task 9 step 6 names the fallback (an empty dist dir).
Adding the three harnesses to the CI test job is inferred from the repository already running release-push.test.sh there; drop it if the reviewer objects.
Two sibling kind rigs (legion-81, legion-25b) are live on this box; the rig's instance scoping is what keeps them apart - never reuse their names or ports.

implement: legion-worker: the jj workspace, handoff, push, PR-body and proof rules for the implementer; the real kind run in Task 9 is this phase's own production-like proof (deployment instructions: the builder tests before merge)
test: legion-worker: re-run the implementer's recipe (both instances) or drive the same surface independently, record implementerProof and the tester's own E2E line with a negative control; the checkpoint lines and the four absence checks are the observable surface
review: legion-worker: one review per round via the reviews API with the Legion footer; verify E2E facts on GitHub; thermonuclear-deep-review and thermonuclear-code-quality once at the head (the PR is not docs-only)
